scope: Read-only existing CLI/runtime discovery. No daemon start, feature/permission change, global installation, container run/pull, service mutation, engine workload or cloud call.

rows.label: linux-capabilities
args:
printf 'SYSTEM
'; uname -srmo; printf 'OS_RELEASE
'; cat /etc/os-release; printf 'DOCKER
'; timeout 10s docker version; printf 'DOCKER_EXIT=%s
' "$?"; printf 'ENGINES
'; for tool in kafka-server-start.sh kafka-topics.sh rabbitmq-server rabbitmqctl redis-server redis-cli qdrant airflow flink spark-submit terraform java; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v "$tool"; else printf '%s MISSING
' "$tool"; fi; done; printf 'PYTHON
'; python3 --version; printf 'SERVICES
'; systemctl is-active docker containerd; printf 'RAM
'; free -b; printf 'DISK
'; df -B1 /; printf 'PROCESS_RSS_KIB
'; ps -eo pid,comm,rss --sort=-rss | head -18; printf 'OPT_CACHE_LOCATIONS
'; ls /opt; printf 'LOCAL_BIN
'; ls /usr/local/bin
